item.title: Judge sides with New York Times in challenge to policy limiting reporters’ access to Pentagon
item.description: A federal judge agreed Friday to block the Trump administration from enforcing a policy limiting news reporters’ access to the Pentagon, agreeing with The New York Times that key portions of the new rules are unlawful.

item.title: Judge orders Voice of America be put back together again. What are the chances that will happen?
